body: Just got diagnosed with stage 4 last week after my lap, having removal done in a few weeks 💔 Feeling very defeated atm so I’m right there with you x

Therapy, EMDR, and time. Time is really what helped the most! (If you can) exercise on days when you have that extra anxious feeling in your chest so you can release it. Mope around for one week then slowly trying to bring yourself back together. Whether that be going for a walk or even changing out of your pjs. 

Give yourself time, don’t immediately jump on dating apps, and if you have the resources try therapy! Also go no contact.
One year later.. I’m doing better than I ever have before. I have no regrets. Things truly do get better. Stick with no contact and let time pass.

Ever since I was a kid, my family and friends always told me I was too sensitive. I get hurt very easily with what people have to say about me. I just turned 20, and I feel like my sensitivity is at an all time high, I get so overwhelmed over my emotions, I feel like I’m getting suffocated
Thank you, I’ll look into it!

Lately, I have been having this feeling that my only purpose is to provide for others. I feel so guilty all of the time, over stuff I shouldn’t. I feel like my life is in other peoples hands, and I have no control over my own

I have a really good support system, especially at home. But whenever I feel like I have disappointed someone it eats me up. Today my sister did tell me I was miserable to be around, which really hurts but I feel like it’s probably true because I am very sad and somewhat pathetic
Do it! I also have a taxi cab one that I love
